### Upland Software Earns 43 Badges in G2’s Fall 2026 Market Reports


08/25/2026


AUSTIN, Texas--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[Upland Software, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fuplandsoftware.com%2F&esheet=54594096&newsitemid=20260825982678&lan=en-US&anchor=Upland+Software%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=3d8b1971175add1fbdeba603a771735e) (Nasdaq: UPLD), a provider of enterprise intelligence that turns knowledge, content, and data into actionable AI-powered outcomes, today announced it has earned 43 badges in the G2 Fall 2026 market reports, driven by customer reviews of its AI-powered solutions. Leading the results were[Upland RightAnswers](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fuplandsoftware.com%2Frightanswers%2F&esheet=54594096&newsitemid=20260825982678&lan=en-US&anchor=Upland+RightAnswers&index=2&md5=1511bc0b3e35cedcf3bf39e492754e2d) and[Upland Panviva](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fuplandsoftware.com%2Fpanviva%2F&esheet=54594096&newsitemid=20260825982678&lan=en-US&anchor=Upland+Panviva&index=3&md5=ae4d22a7d4673e9b66c30013fb1bdd98) , the company's AI-powered knowledge management solutions, which together secured the most badges of all Upland products.[Upland BA Insight](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fuplandsoftware.com%2Fbainsight%2F&esheet=54594096&newsitemid=20260825982678&lan=en-US&anchor=Upland+BA+Insight&index=4&md5=495291d902795b386e2fb367b0968b4b) , an AI enablement solution, was also recognized with several badges, while[Upland Qvidian](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fuplandsoftware.com%2Fqvidian%2F&esheet=54594096&newsitemid=20260825982678&lan=en-US&anchor=Upland+Qvidian&index=5&md5=df6a2d0d908f181ad0657f24db2bfb93) , the company's AI-powered proposal and RFP automation solution, also earned distinction.


Upland Software Earns 43 Badges in G2’s Fall 2026 Market Reports


"These badges are proof points of a bigger shift: we're not just building software, we're building the intelligence layer that helps enterprises unify their information and put it to work," said Austin Woody, Chief Strategy Officer and Group General Manager at Upland Software. "That shift only happens because our teams stay relentlessly focused on our customers, understanding what's actually slowing them down and solving for it. It's the same focus behind our recent realignment of the business around the customer, and this recognition tells us that focus is paying off. It's a responsibility we take seriously as we keep building toward what's next."


A recent RightAnswers G2 reviewer said, “I like the flexibility they provide to us. We are a smaller company compared to some of the other customers they have. But they still treat us with respect. There were a lot of requests we've had to ask that were difficult to work with. But I appreciate the work and patience they have with us, as we try and ensure best service to our users.”

“Rankings on G2 reports are based on data provided to us by real software buyers,” said Sara Rossio, Chief Product Officer at G2. “Potential buyers know they can trust these insights when researching and selecting software because they’re rooted in vetted, verified, and authentic reviews.”


G2 is the world’s largest and most trusted software marketplace. More than 80 million people annually – including employees at all Fortune 500 companies – use G2 to make smarter software decisions based on authentic peer reviews.
